title: Library Management
summary: Search, borrow and return books, limits, fines and reservations.
description: Design a library system for members and librarians. Members search the catalogue, borrow and return physical book copies, reserve books that are on loan, and pay fines for late returns.

requirements.text: Members can search books by title, author or subject.
A book can have several physical copies; members borrow and return copies.
A member may hold at most 5 books at a time.
Each loan has a due date; late returns incur a fine per day.
Members can reserve a book whose copies are all on loan, and are notified when one is returned.
Librarians add and remove books and copies.

constraints: Many members use the system at once; two members must not borrow the same copy.
Notifications go through an interface (email/SMS are out of scope).
Focus on the domain; persistence can be repositories.

changeRequest.title: E-books with licence limits
changeRequest.text: Add e-books. Each e-book has a fixed number of concurrent licences; a loan takes a licence and returns it automatically at the due date. E-books do not incur late fines.
